verdict.rationale: Experimentation with significance reporting is a fair axis for a web analytics product, but the evidence pack never documents an A/B testing feature, variant assignment, or statistical significance reporting. Goals, funnels, custom properties and period comparisons are adjacent analytics features. Using custom properties to segment variants would be a user-side workaround, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can run A/B experiments with goal metrics and statistical significance reported on the results
